plan.failureSummary: The page.ai cached selector (#nav > nav > div:nth-of-type(1) > div:nth-of-type(1) > div:nth-of-type(2) > button) previously matched 'Developers' but now resolves to the 'Solutions' navigation button due to navigation layout changes. This caused page.ai to open the wrong menu and fail to navigate to the docs URL.
observedIndicators: Cached CSS selector '#nav > nav > div:nth-of-type(1) > div:nth-of-type(1) > div:nth-of-type(2) > button' clicked the 'Solutions' button instead of 'Developers'.
Failure screenshot shows the 'Solutions' dropdown open on the homepage ('https://www.checklyhq.com/').
Assertion 'expect(page.url()).toEqual(\"https://www.checklyhq.com/docs/\")' failed because navigation to the documentation page never occurred.
Historical runs show successful self-healing when re-evaluated dynamically.

remediationSteps.summary: Clear page.ai cache and retry test
remediationSteps.details: Clear the cached page.ai instructions for checkly.test.ts and re-run in autonomous mode to generate updated selectors for the Developers dropdown menu.

plan.notes: Clearing the deterministic page.ai cache will allow the autonomous agent to locate the 'Developers' navigation button and documentation link correctly from the live DOM.
